neighbours.label: verb of shielding something from harm or exposing it to harm (protect / expose / free … from)
fire: The farmers built a fence to protect the sheep from wolves.
Sunscreen helps protect your skin from harmful rays.
A thick wax layer helps protect the car paint from salt.
The new law aims to protect children from online abuse.
Vaccines protect the population from serious disease.
She covered the plants with sheets to protect them from frost.
Firewalls are used to protect networks from intruders.
The crew wore masks to protect themselves from the smoke.
quiet: The farmers built a fence to keep the sheep near the barn.
Sunscreen comes in bottles of many different sizes.
A thick wax layer makes the car paint look shiny.
The new law aims to give children more time outdoors.
Vaccines are stored in the clinic's large fridge.
She covered the plants with sheets to keep them tidy.
Firewalls are listed in the network settings menu.
The crew wore masks to look like characters from the film.

notes: Card: ' protect' x5, ' exposing' x3, ' free', 保护; - pole is add/put/insert. Probe: 'helps protect the wood from rain' 0.43, 'to protect your hands' 0.21, 'expose the cells' 0.12, 'exposing themselves' 0.10, 'free the hostages' 0.15. Strongest on protect; expose/free weaker.
